tagline: Leading North American Energy Infrastructure Company
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is a key indicator for energy sector companies, as it reflects investments in energy infrastructure and future production capacity.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in energy infrastructure and production capacity.
kpis.description: Discretionary investments in expansion projects and contributions to joint ventures reflect KMI's commitment to developing new energy capacity.
kpis.signal: Increase in investments in energy infrastructure.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend paid to shareholders per common share.
kpis.description: The dividend per share declared for 2026 represents a 2% increase compared to dividends declared in 2025.
kpis.signal: Increase in the declared annual dividend.

risks.title: Energy Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the risk related to fluctuations in crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGL) prices. The use of derivative instruments for hedging is detailed, indicating significant market sensitivity. The language used suggests ongoing concern about this risk.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Debt
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A details KMI's exposure to interest rate fluctuations on both fixed-rate and variable-rate debt. Potential changes in fair value (over a billion dollars for fixed-rate debt) indicate notable severity.

risks.title: Counterparty Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Counterparty credit risk is mentioned in the context of derivative contracts. Although KMI selects counterparties with high credit ratings, the text acknowledges that losses could occur. Active management of this risk is emphasized.

risks.title: Dividend and Reinvestment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly stated in the Risks Related to Ownership of Our Capital Stock section, highlighting potential conflicts between dividend payments and reinvestment in the business. The non-cumulative nature of dividends adds to the concern.

risks.title: Subsidiary Debt Guarantee Risk
risks.score_rationale: The Summarized Combined Financial Information for Guarantee of Securities of Subsidiaries section explains the cross-guarantee mechanism. This means KMI and its guarantor subsidiaries are jointly and severally liable for the debt, concentrating risk within the Obligated Group.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk (Limited)
risks.score_rationale: Foreign exchange risk is mentioned but appears largely mitigated by the use of currency swaps to convert euro-denominated debt into U.S. dollar-denominated debt. The reference is brief, and the risk is described as eliminated by these instruments.

ai_positioning.summary: KMI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
